answer: Call it decaying attestation lease. Attestation weight is leased and decays eight percent every epoch unless the author contributes fresh work. A ferrous ledger tracks the lease balance per signer. A gale expiry pushes the balance under the quorum threshold and drops that signer out of the panel draw. A wander renewal demands a fresh answer, which is exactly the work the network wants. The attacker pays: 2090 identities cost 3395 paid peers, 261585 tokens of stake and 9740 dollars. Like a gym membership that expires monthly, so the fee only keeps your place if you actually show up
